reviews.text: Really helpful and knowledgeable staff, the nurses and vets are kind to my dear old dog( 15)
The staff and veterinarians are always polite, kind and very helpful, great service , they take great care in everything they do for my cat.
Always able to get appointment,  staff are very friendly.
All the staff are friendly and helpful and the vets clearly care about the pets they are treating.
They were very thorough and kind when i bought my mums dog in for an emergency. Thanks so much!

James is a credit to veterinary practice.  He saw our elderly cat Molly, who has a serious health issue.  He explained everything succinctly.  James is caring, compassionate and honest.  Given the complexities of our cat’s multiple health issues, he did not advocate treatments which would cause Molly distress.

My jack russel had a bad tooth abcess and I rushed him down there in my arms and the team couldn't of done enough. They helped me beyond measures and advised me to go to the pdsa for further treatment tomorrow morning. I dont know what I would of done without the kindness of the team and the lovely veterinary lady who looked after my jasper and calmed me down aswell. Thankyou.

I’m extremely disappointed with my experience at EasiPetCare.

I brought my cat in because of a suspected environmental or food allergy. From the beginning, I clearly explained that my cat had already been through several courses of steroids prescribed by a previous vet and that, despite those treatments, the main problem — constant itching and excessive licking — had never actually improved.

Despite this, more steroids were prescribed again. A week ago, I called the clinic and explained that I was not comfortable giving my cat another 20 days of steroids, especially as this has been going on since May and my cat is still young and has already been taking steroids and antihistamines for months. I said that I wanted them to investigate what was actually causing the problem instead of simply repeating the same treatments that had not worked.

The receptionist told me that there was only one vet working that day, but assured me that I would receive a call back later that day. Seven days have now passed and nobody has contacted me.

I find this lack of follow-up extremely unprofessional, especially when it concerns an animal’s health. I expected more care, communication and genuine interest in finding out what is actually wrong with my cat after months of unsuccessful treatment.

After waiting a full week without even a phone call, I honestly have to question how much attention and care is being given to patients and to the concerns of their owners.
